mapper.select: SELECT role_name AS roleName, MIN(role_no) AS roleNo, role_level AS roleLevel FROM ROLE WHERE company_no = #{companyNo} GROUP BY role_name, role_level ORDER BY role_level DESC

SELECT r.role_no AS roleNo, r.role_name AS roleName, r.user_no AS userNo, r.role_level AS roleLevel, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, p.position_name AS position, k.rank_name AS rank FROM ROLE r JOIN USERS u ON r.user_no = u.user_no LEFT JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no LEFT JOIN RANK k ON t.rank_no = k.rank_no WHERE r.company_no = #{companyNo} AND r.role_name = #{roleName} AND r.user_no IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROLE(role_no, role_name, role_level, company_no, user_no) VALUES ('R' || LPAD(SEQ_ROLE_NO.NEXTVAL, 6, '0'), #{roleName}, 50, #{companyNo}, NULL)
mapper.delete: delete from role where role_no=#{roleNo} and company_no=#{companyNo}
mapper.select: SELECT u.user_no AS userNo, u.user_id AS userId, u.user_name AS userName, u.email AS email, p.position_name AS position, r.rank_name AS rank FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN TITLE t ON u.user_no = t.user_no LEFT JOIN POSITION p ON t.position_no = p.position_no LEFT JOIN RANK r ON t.rank_no = r.rank_no WHERE u.company_no = #{companyNo} AND ( u.user_id = #{keyword, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler} OR u.user_name = #{keyword, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler} ) ORDER BY u.user_name, u.user_id
